reviews.title: Doesn’t fit in the NZXT H9 elite with the MSI Z790
reviews.comment: It doesn’t fit in the rear exhaust fan compartment at all in an NZXT H9 Elite Case with the MSI Z790 motherboard I think the I/O shield is too beefy, so I would recommend considering an alternative option if you have the same case & motherboard as the fan is a bit bigger than most 120mm fans. However, it fits well inside my other PC with the NZXT H6 Flow & the Gigabyte B550M K.
reviews.author: Chester
